command: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$node='PE1'; `$cmds=@('display interface brief','display interface','display interface Ethernet1/0/1','display interface Ethernet1/0/2','display ip routing-table','display ip routing-table vpn-instance BJ_In','display mpls lsp','display mpls lsp verbose','display mpls ldp lsp','display mpls forwarding-table','display cpu-usage','display device','display current-configuration'); foreach(`$c in `$cmds){`$e=[System.Uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$node+'/command?cmd='+`$e; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; if(`$o -notmatch 'not found'){Write-Output ('CMD='+`$c); Write-Output `$o}}"
